program: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 — Master Citation Verification Disposition
nonNegotiableBoundary: verified:true records qualified-human-approved source/proposition review. It does not establish an individual VA medical nexus, and population-level association is not converted into individual causation.

decisionPolicy.verifyAsWritten: Bibliographic identity is correct and the source directly supports the bounded proposition encoded in the current mapping without broader causal inference.
decisionPolicy.verifyWithNarrowing: Source is usable, but the mapping/citation language must be narrowed before verification.
decisionPolicy.replaceSource: Current source does not adequately support the proposition; identify a one-for-one replacement before verification.
decisionPolicy.holdProposition: The proposition cannot be verified from the cited evidence without overreach.
decisionPolicy.holdMetadata: Bibliographic/source identity mismatch requires correction before proposition review.
